items.title: Eddie Palmieri — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And my son now is my manager. We’ve traveled together for the last twenty years.

ctx.x: I didn’t say that. I said “the second.” I’ve known him for a long time. Our kids grew up together. How many kids do you have...
My wife and I, we have four daughters and my son. And my son now is my manager. We’ve traveled together for the last twenty years. Anyway, I just wanted to tell the story about how we met.
That’s great. But I wanted to get the family in there, too. So at 17, you’re already leading bands...
